translations.text: I know your works, your toil, and your endurance, and that you cannot tolerate evil people. You tested those who call themselves apostles but are not, and found them to be liars.
And write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: Thus says the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like smoking bronze.
And write to the angel of the church of Philadelphia: Thus says the Holy One, the True One, who holds the key of David, who opens and no one can shut, and shuts and no one can open.
Let anyone who has ears hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with me.
They said in a loud voice, “How long, holy and true Lord, will you refrain from judging and avenging our blood on the inhabitants of the earth?”
And I saw another angel rising from the east, holding the seal of the living God. He cried out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given authority to destroy the earth and the sea.
They will neither hunger nor thirst, and neither the sun nor scorching heat will strike them.
And the Lamb in the midst of his throne will shepherd them and lead them to the spring of life, of living water, for God wiped away every tear from their eyes.
They had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots drawn by many horses rushing into battle.
And the number of their mounted troops was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands. I heard their number.

And I saw horses in the vision, and riders on them who had fiery and hyacinth-colored breastplates burning with sulfur. The horses’ heads were like lions’ heads, and fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
And a third of humanity died from these plagues: from the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that came out of their mouths.
And the angel whom I saw, who placed one foot on the sea and the other on dry land, raised his right hand to heaven.

And I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Now have come the power, the salvation, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Anointed One, for the accuser of our brothers has fallen, who accused them before God day and night.”
And when the dragon saw that he had fallen to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

And another angel came out of heaven, crying out in a loud voice and saying, “You who sit on the cloud, send out your sickle and reap, for the time of reaping has come, and the harvests of the earth are ripe.”
And he was given power to scorch people with fire. People were scorched by intense heat and blasphemed God, who has authority over these plagues, and they did not repent to give glory to God.
Here is wisdom for one who has understanding: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman was seated, and they are seven kings, and there being seven kings.
Therefore her plagues will come upon her in a single day: death, mourning, and famine. And she will be burned with fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judged her.
And a mighty angel took a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “Thus will Babylon, the great city, fall with violence and never be found again.”
And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies gathered to wage war against the one riding the white horse and against his army.
And he said to me, “It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To those who thirst I give freely from the spring of the water of life.”
And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
And the city had no need of the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God illuminated it at all times, and the Lamb was its lamp.
But let the dogs, sorcerers, murderers, idolaters, and all who love falsehood go outside.
